content.title: THE PLAYERS Championship 2026
content.text: THE PLAYERS 2026 in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida, combines the best field in golf with the world-class venue, THE PLAYERS Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass. The tournament takes place from Tuesday through Sunday, March 10 to 15, 2026. Visitors are welcome to attend each day of the championship, including the practice rounds.THE PLAYERS is one of the most anticipated tournaments on the PGA Tour and boasts the biggest purse and the strongest field.There is an app that provides information about everything happening at THE PLAYERS. You can download the app, here.Proceeds from THE PLAYERS benefit Northeast Florida charities and have totaled nearly $110 million since the event moved to Ponte Vedra Beach in 1977.The Tournament Schedule Tuesday, March 10—Practice Round for ProfessionalsWednesday, March 11—Practice Round for ProfessionalsThursday, March 12—First Round of CompetitionFriday, March 13—Second Round of CompetitionSaturday, March 14—Third Round of CompetitionSunday, March 15—Final Round of CompetitionMilitary AppreciationTHE PLAYERS provides all career military (active duty, reserve, military retiree, and one dependent) with complimentary admission to the tournament all week. While at the tournament, members of the military and their dependents may enjoy The Patriots' Outpost, the complimentary hospitality tent.Military Appreciation DayOn Tuesday, March 10, 2026, at 4:00 p.m., The Players will present a Military Appreciation Ceremony on the Island Green 17th hole. The ceremony and concert are open to all with a ticket for Tuesday, but that ticket does not include free parking.Complimentary admission for military members and veterans is available in 2026. Check their website for more information and to order tickets. Active duty and retired service members, as well as reserve and national guard members who are verified through the military identification system, will be provided one free ticket in addition to one free ticket for a dependent. This offer is available while supplies last.Tournament Info Admission: Admission prices vary depending on the day and the type of ticket. All tickets are mobile, and tickets are only available through the online ticket office for THE PLAYERS. Tickets are dynamically priced; each guest is allowed to purchase up to eight tickets per day per transaction. Tickets go on sale November 18, 2025, and can be purchased online here.Parking passes are not included with the tickets. Parking access must be purchased in advance and online, here.Youth Policy: Up to two youths who are 15 and under are admitted free of charge with one ticketed adult on Tuesday through Sunday. Their access is limited to the grounds only. All youths aged six and older must have the appropriate ticket to enter the hospitality venues.When: Tuesday, March 10, to Sunday, March 15, 2026. Tee-offs are in the morning, from 6:30 - 7:30 a.m., and individual events may last all afternoon.Where: TPC Sawgrass, 110 Championship Way in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida 32082. For directions via GPS, use 5387 Palm Valley Road in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.Parking: Parking ranges from $15.00 to $40.00 on Tuesday and Wednesday and from $40.00 to $60.00 on Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Parking passes must be purchased in advance and will be digital passes. To purchase parking tickets, visit here. Guests may ride their bikes or golf carts to the tournament and park free of charge in lot 4W.Accessibility: A designated parking area is available for handicapped guests to make access to the grounds easier. A golf cart shuttle system operates around the grounds. Benches are marked where disabled visitors who are unable to walk far distances can wait to be taken to different areas of the course. The shuttle runs from when the gates open to 30 minutes after play.Getting ThereTournament organizers recommend taking exit 32 on I-95, heading east on County Road 210, which turns into Valley Ridge Boulevard, and then turning right at the intersection of Valley Ridge Boulevard and Nocatee Parkway. Continue on Nocatee Parkway, which becomes Palm Valley Road, which will take you right to TPC Sawgrass.Rideshare: THE PLAYERS Championship has set up rideshares, which will drop off and pick up on ATP Boulevard, at the Couples Entry (near the 15th hole). This is an easy way for spectators to get to and from the event.For more information on THE PLAYERS Championship 2026 visit here. or call (904) 273-3235.To get to THE PLAYERS Championship using GPS: Enter THE PLAYERS Championship for the destination, and then enter the tournament through the Couples Entry.Find Places to Stay in Ponte VedraFor your stay during the tournament, check out our listings for area hotels and vacation rentals.
